changelog:
Initial release of API Health Checker skill.

- Test API endpoints with configurable methods, authentication, and request data.
- Validate response status codes, times, and structure.
- Measure and report on API performance (average, min, max, p95 response times).
- Generate comprehensive health reports with per-endpoint details and recommendations.
summary: Tests API endpoints by sending requests, validating responses, measuring performance, handling authentication, and generating detailed health reports.
